sample: three known version-sensitive task families with NEW mandatory evidence output; not unseen holdout

arms.direct: keyword search over same nine pinned official sources, then live HTTP source reads with exact hash verification; NOT open-web engine search
arms.flat: same six method records and hybrid retriever; same bundle content as flattened text
arms.bundle: complete stored methods via new pack_bundle; identical source/derived-record pool to flat

primary: 6 exact typed decisions per task AND >=2 distinct source URL plus exact returned quote pairs linked to >=2 questions; failed/missing results stay denominator
secondary: blind 0-2 condition/actionable-fix/uncertainty each; actual all-call input/output/cached totals, serialized reference tokens, wall/request/tool seconds
target: 30 percent fewer input+output tokens at equal-or-better exact, citation and blinded quality; evaluate direct and flat separately
limits_of_inference: Single repeat; provider caches and shared-host delay uncontrolled
Previously curated Korean methods vs English originals; translation and preparation not free
Preprocessing and grading measured separately where observable, no dollar cost estimate
No outcome or opinion published from this pilot
